task: Run the DeepSeek topology adapter inside unmodified stock RCO optimization on a tiny model.

hardware.machine_id_hash_recipe: sha256sum /etc/machine-id over the file bytes, including its trailing newline
hardware.concurrent_state: GPU0 was owned by the existing llama-imatrix calibration process; GPU1 had no compute process before or after the probe

procedure.model: in-memory 1-layer DeepseekV41ForCausalLM, hidden 64, vocabulary 128, two routed experts, top-1, one shared expert
procedure.calibration: one deterministic 8-token tensor, supplied in memory
procedure.patch_boundary: only stock CLI model/tokenizer/calibration loading were supplied in memory; stock build_ref_cache, optimize, STE state, final evaluation, and artifact writing ran; stock install_wrappers was replaced process-locally with the DeepSeek adapter

faithful_eval_follow_up.procedure: process-locally replaced stock install_wrappers and final evaluate_with_mask with the DeepSeek adapter; stock reference construction and Gumbel-STE optimization remained unchanged
faithful_eval_follow_up.routing_semantics: hard survival mask zeros pruned routing weights without renormalizing surviving weights

non_claims: This is a one-step tiny-model structural integration, not a quality search or convergence result.
The calibration tensor, model loader, and tokenizer were in-memory test substitutes; corpus loading and released-checkpoint loading were not exercised.
Stock RCO final hard-mask evaluation ran, but its softmax-router assumption is not deployment-faithful to V4.1 sqrtsoftplus scores and correction biases.
The follow-up final evaluation is faithful to the adapter's hard-mask routing semantics, but it has not been compared with a physically materialized checkpoint or deployment engine.
No released DeepSeek checkpoint shard was opened, downloaded, converted, quantized, packed, or benchmarked.
The result says nothing about pruning quality, runtime performance, or the 216-of-384 budget lane.
GPU0 calibration and the gated DeepSeek NVMe copy watcher remained active and undisturbed.
